FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "YEAR" FROM crime_incidents) y
CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "DISTRICT" FROM crime_incidents WHERE "DISTRICT" IS NOT NULL) d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM crime_incidents ci
  WHERE ci."YEAR" = y."YEAR" AND ci."DISTRICT" = d."DISTRICT" AND ci."CRIME_OFFENSE_GROUP" = 'Homicide'

    SELECT district_id
    FROM   district_names
),

/* 2. List of all years that appear in the crime data */
all_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "YEAR"
    FROM   crime_incidents
),

/* 3. Build every possible (year, district) combination */
year_district_grid AS (
    SELECT y."YEAR", d.district_id
    FROM   all_years   y
    CROSS  JOIN all_districts d
),

/* 4. Count homicide offenses per (year, district) */
homicide_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ci."YEAR"          AS yr,
        ci."DISTRICT"      AS district,
        COUNT(*)           AS homicide_cnt
    FROM   crime_incidents ci
    WHERE  ci."CRIME_OFFENSE_LABEL" ILIKE '%HOMICIDE%'
        OR ci."CRIME_CATEGORY"      ILIKE '%Homicide%'
    GROUP BY ci."YEAR", ci."DISTRICT"
)

/* 5. For each year, count districts that have no homicide record */
SELECT
    yd."YEAR"                                   AS year,
    COUNT(*)                                    AS districts_with_zero_homicide
FROM   year_district_grid yd
LEFT   JOIN homicide_counts hc
       ON yd."YEAR" = hc.yr
      AND yd.district_id = hc.district
WHERE  hc.homicide_cnt IS NULL          -- no homicide recorded for that district/year
GROUP  BY yd."YEAR"
ORDER  BY yd."YEAR";
